mentions.name: vorfract
mentions.description: A voxel sandbox game that uses Voronoi cells as voxels instead of regular cubic ones. The malleable Voronoi voxels make shapes like round or hollow worlds a natural outcome, and the game supports building structures such as castles with slanted walls, custom stairs, tables and chairs. Includes a CRT filter and pixelation options, with future work on building less blocky things like round towers. A free WebGL web version is available.

mentions.name: vorfract
mentions.description: A 3D voxel world built from voronoi cells, where collections of points arranged in different patterns generate a solid world. It includes tools for cutting the cells; since voronoi cells are convex polyhedra, almost any shape can be formed by combining several cells.
